# Customization reference

Docs AI Island exposes semantic configuration for common choices and a stable styling contract for precise visual control. Import the default stylesheet, then override tokens through the typed `theme` option or scoped CSS.

## Theme tokens

Every token works both as a key in `config.theme` and as a CSS custom property on `[data-docs-ai-island]`.

| Theme key | CSS property | Default | Category | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accent` | `--docs-ai-island-accent` | `#7567e8` | Color | Accent used by the built-in trigger icon and focus treatment. |
| `surface` | `--docs-ai-island-surface` | `rgb(255 255 255 / 88%)` | Color | Trigger and menu surface color. |
| `foreground` | `--docs-ai-island-foreground` | `#202126` | Color | Primary text and icon color. |
| `muted` | `--docs-ai-island-muted` | `#686a74` | Color | Secondary text and icon color. |
| `faint` | `--docs-ai-island-faint` | `#8f919a` | Color | Low-emphasis labels, arrows, and chevrons. |
| `border` | `--docs-ai-island-border` | `rgb(29 31 38 / 11%)` | Color | Border and divider color. |
| `hover` | `--docs-ai-island-hover` | `rgb(30 31 38 / 6%)` | Color | Interactive hover, focus, and pending-state fill. |
| `focusRing` | `--docs-ai-island-focus-ring` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--docs-ai-island-accent) 32%, transparent)` | Color | Outer focus-ring color. |
| `shadow` | `--docs-ai-island-shadow` | `0 20px 56px rgb(20 22 30 / 18%), 0 1px 2px rgb(20 22 30 / 9%)` | Surface | Menu box shadow. |
| `menuWidth` | `--docs-ai-island-menu-width` | `340px` | Menu | Preferred menu width before viewport clamping. |
| `menuRadius` | `--docs-ai-island-menu-radius` | `18px` | Menu | Menu corner radius. |
| `menuPadding` | `--docs-ai-island-menu-padding` | `6px` | Menu | Inner menu padding in compact density. |
| `itemHeight` | `--docs-ai-island-item-height` | `50px` | Menu | Minimum primary Action height in compact density. |
| `triggerWidth` | `--docs-ai-island-trigger-width` | `158px` | Trigger | Trigger width. |
| `triggerHeight` | `--docs-ai-island-trigger-height` | `44px` | Trigger | Trigger height. |
| `triggerRadius` | `--docs-ai-island-trigger-radius` | `16px` | Trigger | Trigger corner radius. |
| `offsetBlock` | `--docs-ai-island-offset-block` | `24px` | Position | Distance from the block-end viewport edge before safe-area inset. |
| `offsetInline` | `--docs-ai-island-offset-inline` | `24px` | Position | Distance from the inline viewport edge for left and right placements. |
| `zIndex` | `--docs-ai-island-z-index` | `100` | Position | Island stacking level. |
| `fontFamily` | `--docs-ai-island-font-family` | `inherit` | Typography | Font family inherited by the Island. |
| `backdropFilter` | `--docs-ai-island-backdrop-filter` | `blur(24px) saturate(140%)` | Surface | Backdrop effect used by frosted surfaces. |
| `motionDuration` | `--docs-ai-island-motion-duration` | `180ms` | Motion | Base open, close, and chevron animation duration. |
| `motionEasing` | `--docs-ai-island-motion-easing` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` | Motion | Base open, close, and chevron animation easing. |

### Typed configuration

```ts
mountDocsAiIsland({
  theme: {
    accent: "var(--vp-c-brand-1)",
    menuRadius: "14px",
    itemHeight: "54px",
    backdropFilter: "blur(18px) saturate(125%)",
  },
})
```

### CSS override

```css
[data-docs-ai-island] {
  --docs-ai-island-accent: var(--sl-color-accent);
  --docs-ai-island-font-family: var(--sl-font);
  --docs-ai-island-offset-block: 32px;
}
```

Runtime `theme` values are inline custom properties and therefore take precedence over ordinary author CSS. Prefer one method per token. Color-scheme and density variants intentionally replace some defaults; a runtime `theme` value still wins.

## Stable parts

Parts are stable styling hooks under the Island root. They are not global selectors: always scope overrides through `[data-docs-ai-island]`. Optional content, custom icons, group kinds, and Action configuration determine whether a particular part is rendered.

| Selector | Default element | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[data-part="action"]` | `<button>` | Primary Action control. |
| `[data-part="action-arrow"]` | `<span>` | Trailing handoff arrow on a primary Action. |
| `[data-part="action-copy"]` | `<span>` | Text wrapper shared by primary and utility Actions. |
| `[data-part="action-description"]` | `<small>` | Optional primary Action description. |
| `[data-part="action-label"]` | `<strong>` | Action label. |
| `[data-part="actions"]` | `<div>` | Primary Action group container. |
| `[data-part="chevron"]` | `<span>` | Trigger disclosure indicator. |
| `[data-part="group-label"]` | `<span>` | Optional Action-group label. |
| `[data-part="header"]` | `<div>` | Menu header container. |
| `[data-part="header-copy"]` | `<span>` | Menu-title and page-title wrapper. |
| `[data-part="icon"]` | `<svg>` | Built-in decorative icon. |
| `[data-part="icon-frame"]` | `<span>` | Action icon alignment wrapper. |
| `[data-part="live-region"]` | `<div>` | Polite status announcement region. |
| `[data-part="menu"]` | `<div>` | Dialog-like Action menu. |
| `[data-part="page-title"]` | `<small>` | Current Page Context title. |
| `[data-part="title"]` | `<strong>` | Menu title. |
| `[data-part="trigger"]` | `<button>` | Island disclosure trigger. |
| `[data-part="trigger-label"]` | `<strong>` | Visible trigger label. |
| `[data-part="utilities"]` | `<div>` | Utility Action group container. |
| `[data-part="utility"]` | `<button>` | Compact utility Action control. |

```css
[data-docs-ai-island] [data-part="trigger"] {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

[data-docs-ai-island] [data-part="action-description"] {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
```

The default element column describes the current built-in renderer. The `data-part` value is the compatibility contract; do not target internal structure, child order, or undocumented classes.
